# Kamil Wyremski - Full Stack Web Developer

> Kamil Wyremski is a Polish Full Stack Web Developer specializing in custom web application development, PHP, JavaScript, React, Symfony, and MySQL. He creates and sells turn-key PHP scripts for classifieds, job portals, real estate, automotive, and directory websites.

## Core Services & Expertise
- Full Stack Web Development (PHP, React.js, JavaScript ES6+, Symfony, HTML5/CSS3/SASS, MySQL)
- Turn-key Web Scripts & CMS Solutions
- Custom Web Application Development
- API Integration & SEO Optimization

## Featured Web Scripts & Software (English & Polish)
- [Notice3](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/notice3): Classifieds portal script in PHP & MySQL (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/notice3)
- [Demoty2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/demoty2): Portal script for viral images and meme sites (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/demoty2)
- [Motonotice](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/motonotice): Automotive classifieds portal script (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/motonotice)
- [Jobnotice](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/jobnotice): Job board & employment portal script (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/jobnotice)
- [Cuadro](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/cuadro): Real estate & property listings script (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/cuadro)
- [Festa2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/festa2): Events & directory listings portal script (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/festa2)
- [Corta](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/corta): URL shortener script with analytics (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/corta)
- [Holmes2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/holmes2): Business & company directory script (PL: https://wyremski.pl/skrypt/holmes2)
